Definition: from G5083; a watching, i.e. (figuratively) observance, or (concretely) a prison:--hold.
BiblicalUsage: tḗrēsis is the Bible's word for a keeping, a prison. In Acts 4:3, they laid hands on them, and it appears again in 1 Corinthians 7:19.
TheologicalSignificance: Peter and John locked up overnight remind me that keeping God's command matters more than keeping out of trouble.
